description: Mark a feedback item as "won't fix" in layernote, with a mandatory reason that is posted to the item’s thread. Use this instead of resolve_feedback when it is deliberately not acted on: e.g. the item is a false positive, intentional, or out of scope. The team sees the item as dismissed with the explanation, not as fixed.

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

reason.description: Why this will not be fixed (shown to the team)

name: wont_fix_feedback
title: Mark a feedback item as won’t-fix
